seoTitle: How to Find SMTP, POP & IMAP Details in Hostinger
metaDescription: Locate your Hostinger email's SMTP, POP, and IMAP settings so you can configure Gmail, Outlook, or any custom app correctly.
intro: Setting up your Hostinger email in a third-party app like Gmail or Outlook depends on having the exact SMTP, POP, and IMAP details, which aren't always easy to find on your own. This guide shows where to locate these settings in your control panel and how to use them in your preferred email client.

steps.heading: Open your Hostinger email settings
steps.body: Go to the email section of your Hostinger control panel where your mailbox configuration details are listed.

steps.heading: Find your SMTP, POP, and IMAP details
steps.body: Locate the exact server addresses, ports, and encryption type needed to connect your email client.

steps.heading: Copy the settings into your email client
steps.body: Enter these details into Gmail, Outlook, or another app to connect your Hostinger mailbox.

steps.heading: Troubleshoot configuration issues
steps.body: If email isn't sending or receiving correctly, double-check the ports and encryption settings against what Hostinger provides.

faq.question: Where do I find my Hostinger SMTP settings?
faq.answer: They're located in the email configuration section of your Hostinger control panel, alongside your POP and IMAP details.

faq.question: Can I use these details in Gmail or Outlook?
faq.answer: Yes, once you have the correct settings you can add your Hostinger email to Gmail, Outlook, or another client.

faq.question: Why isn't my email working after adding it to an app?
faq.answer: It's often due to an incorrect port or encryption setting, so it helps to recheck the exact values from Hostinger.

faq.question: What's the difference between POP and IMAP?
faq.answer: Both are ways to retrieve mail, and the guide covers finding both sets of details so you can choose what suits your setup.
